title: A Flux-Correction Form of the Third-Order Edge-Based Scheme for a General Numerical Flux Function
summary: In this short note, we present a flux-correction form of the third-order edge-based scheme for the Euler equations that enables the direct use of a general flux function. The core idea is to replace, without loss of accuracy, the arithmetic average of the flux extrapolations by a general numerical flux evaluated at the edge midpoint, together with a correction term.
